rationale: Explicit user authorization covers a real, bounded, read-only multi-agent acceptance proof. After the current quota lane releases capacity, root supplies distinct non-secret nonces to two same-role explorer parents on disjoint repository questions; one parent must spawn exactly one explorer child after starting. Root plus the two parents and child is the entire 4-slot allocation. Every result must contain its nonce, monotonic start/end timestamps, scope_owned, commands/read evidence, and changed_files=[]; root verifies parent overlap, parent-child forwarding, unchanged worktree fingerprint, and slot utilization. No external CLI/network action, writable ownership, work prompt, or repository mutation is authorized.
